sehemu: Part V: Court of Appeal of the United Republic
jina: Quorum at sittings of the Court of Appeal
maudhui: (1) The quorum at every sitting of the Court of Appeal shall be not fewer than three Justices of Appeal. (2) In every appeal, a question requiring determination by the Court of Appeal shall be decided according to the opinion of the majority of the Justices of Appeal who heard the appeal.
vifungu: (1) The quorum at every sitting of the Court of Appeal shall be not fewer than three Justices of Appeal.
(2) In every appeal, a question requiring determination by the Court of Appeal shall be decided according to the opinion of the majority of the Justices of Appeal who heard the appeal.
